name: Stress Testing Image Watermarks
description: A benchmark and competition designed to evaluate the robustness of invisible watermarking techniques against removal attacks while preserving image quality.

cr:input.name: ETI Benchmark Dataset
cr:input.description: A dataset of 600 images, including 300 for the Black-box track and 300 for the Beige-box track. Images were generated using Stable Diffusion 2.1 and Flux 1 [dev], with watermarks applied using in-processing and post-processing techniques such as Gaussian Shading, StegaStamp, JigMark, PRC, StableSignature, and Trufo.
cr:input.encodingFormat: [FILL IN THE BLANK: dataset encoding format]
cr:input.contentUrl: [FILL IN THE BLANK: dataset download URL]

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: Predicted images after watermark removal attacks. Outputs are evaluated for watermark detection performance (True Positive Rate at 0.1% FPR) and image quality degradation using multiple metrics.

field.name: image_id
field.description: Unique identifier for each image, e.g., 'image_001'.

field.name: watermark_detection_score
field.description: Post-attack watermark detection score, with lower values indicating better watermark removal.

field.name: image_quality_score
field.description: Image quality degradation score, with lower values indicating better preservation of visual quality.

cr:implementation.entryPoint: [FILL IN THE BLANK: entry point script]

cr:evaluation.primaryMetric: Euclidean distance between image quality degradation (Q) and watermark detection performance (A)
cr:evaluation.notes: The primary metric minimizes the Euclidean distance between Q and A, where Q aggregates eight image quality metrics and A represents the TPR at 0.1% FPR.
